proof_body:
by
  intro c d hd h hc n
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ n ih =>
    rw [Finset.sum_Icc_succ_top (by omega), ih]
    have h0 := hc 1 (by omega)
    have h1 := hc (n + 1) (by omega)
    have h2 := hc (n + 1 + 1) (by omega)
    have e : c (n + 1 + 1) - c (n + 1) = d := by
      rw [h (n + 1) (by omega)]
      ring
    have t : 1 / (c (n + 1) * c (n + 1 + 1)) = (1 / d) * (1 / c (n + 1) - 1 / c (n + 1 + 1)) := by
      field_simp
      linarith
    rw [t]
    ring
